Subject: Re: Quick ask — small starter credit for our pilot

Hi — good question. We don't currently enforce promo scoping at the API feature level (generation vs embeddings) for single-use credits because it complicates redemption and edge cases, but two options:

1) Use the $1,200 general credit (BRIGHTLANE-PLG-2026-1200) and we will monitor consumption live; if you want, we can pause embedding endpoints at the proxy for the pilot window as an operational control.

2) If you require absolute enforcement, we can issue two separate coupons (generation-only + embeddings-only) — that requires a second manual promo and a short ops ticket (24–48 hour turnaround).

Given the tight timeline and the PO timing, I recommend option 1 and we'll add a monitoring alert on your account to notify us if >20% of consumption goes to embeddings. If that sounds OK I'll mark the promo active; Jonas, please confirm activation timestamp when you flip the code live.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
